items.title: What Does UnitedHealth Group (UNH) IRS Tax Scrutiny Mean For Investors?
items.summary: UnitedHealth Group (NYSE:UNH) is facing IRS scrutiny over how it priced transactions with a foreign subsidiary, with the agency proposing sizable tax adjustments across multiple years. The IRS move focuses on transfer pricing and could significantly raise UnitedHealth Group's taxable income if the proposed changes are ultimately applied.
